# Tau Prolog 0.3.4

Unmodified runtime files from the `tau-prolog@0.3.4` npm distribution:

- `modules/core.js` → `core.js`
- `modules/lists.js` → `lists.js`
- `LICENSE` → `LICENSE`

Source repository: <https://github.com/tau-prolog/tau-prolog>
Distribution: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tau-prolog@0.3.4/>

The JavaScript hashes are identical to the previous integrity-checked CDN
dependencies. The Prolog worker now loads this local snapshot, so its engine
startup no longer depends on the CDN. `SHA256SUMS` covers these files and this
provenance note. Preserve upstream bytes and license when updating the snapshot.

The course's `not/1` spelling is supplied by the repository-owned worker as an
alias for ISO `\+/1`. It does not modify this vendor snapshot.
